name: Surprised_1
short_caption: The robot pulls its arms backward and slightly raises them in a sudden, startled reaction.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing posture. It suddenly pulls its elbows backward and tenses its fingers, drawing its forearms slightly upward and outward in a quick, startled recoil. It holds this surprised, tense pose briefly before slowly relaxing its arms back down to the neutral starting position.
safety_notes: The rapid retraction of the elbows requires small clearance directly behind the robot's upper torso.
